mobbin:c537e383-521f-4785-8478-0ba54a3e6.summary: From the share sidebar, the user sets an expiration via presets or calendar, confirms Dec 31 11:59pm, and lands on a set expiry with Edit or clear.
steps: Expiry picker with presets and time
Expiration set with Edit or clear
steal: Share settings stay in a side panel next to the video, so the user sets them without leaving the review (screen 1).
Quick choices ('24 Hours', '1 Week', '2 Weeks') sit above a calendar and time picker, which suits short sharing windows after a debrief (screen 2).
The chosen expiry ('Dec 31 at 11:59pm') is then shown in one short line with Edit and an X to clear it (screens 3 to 4).
Comments, Downloads and 'Show all versions' are separate switches next to Security (passphrase and expiry) (screens 1 and 4).
mobbin:c537e383-521f-4785-8478-0ba54a3e6.fit: Debrief and review: the best match for sharing video after a debrief, with settings next to playback, quick expiry choices and a Downloads switch. Essentials still needs consent before identifiable learners can be downloaded.
